summary.text: Light Horse Crossing is an immortal killer move named when Liu Chang fights Hei Lou Lan.

claims.text: In Northern Plains, Liu Chang fights Hei Lou Lan, who uses Black Moon as her alias, while over ten Gu Immortals watch from the surroundings. Liu Chang activates light horse crossing. A small steed appears below his legs, carrying him into the sky with rapid speed. The movement killer move lets him maintain a fixed distance from Hei Lou Lan throughout the battle. After a previous loss against her, he chose a long ranged tactic this time.

Hei Lou Lan activates dark capital strength biao. The black tiger’s speed puts Liu Chang at a complete disadvantage, with no strength to retaliate. If he could use light horse crossing, he might be able to escape for some time, but he has fallen into a passive position and has to focus all his strength on maintaining his defensive methods, otherwise the black tiger might turn him into meat paste. A strike sends him flying to the ground, and he falls unconscious.
